Name: Emerald Barrage
Description: Three tiny ghost-like emeralds appear and float around your hands for the duration. When you cast the spell—and as a bonus action on each of your turns thereafter—you can crush one of the emeralds and choose an augmentation below to unleash an emerald barrage from your hands at a target you can see within range: Imperfect Augmentation: Make a ranged spell attack with a -5 penalty. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage. Polished Augmentation: The barrage automatically hits a target and deals 2d6 force damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, an additional ghostly emerald appears for each slot level above 2nd.
